Name: Jesse
Summary: Jesse of Bethlehem, son of Obed, was the father of eight sons. Samuel passed over his seven elder sons to anoint the youngest, David, as king, and Jesse later sent David with provisions to his brothers at war.
KeyStory: Jesse watched the prophet pass over seven sons to anoint the shepherd boy he had left with the sheep.
KeyVerses: 1 Samuel 16:1; 1 Samuel 16:10; 1 Samuel 16:11; 1 Samuel 17:17; 1 Samuel 22:3; 1 Chronicles 2:12; 1 Chronicles 2:13; 2 Chronicles 10:16; 2 Chronicles 11:18
RelatedPeople: King David; Eliab, Son of Jesse; Abinadab, Son of Jesse; Shammah, Son of Jesse; Obed, Son of Boaz
LifeLesson: God's choice often skips the impressive sons and rests on the overlooked one.
